C-STABILIZE-DIRTY-RELOAD.IntentSummary: Reproduce the unsafe reload using the real store with mocked filesystem transport, repair only its eligibility/lifetime boundary, and synchronize the actual M-032 contract and verification.
C-STABILIZE-DIRTY-RELOAD.ApprovalBasis: Owner-approved recovery implementation and delegated bounded decisions, 2026-11-09. No new review-agent or repeated clean-streak workflow is required for this exact repair.

MustContain.Text: preserves dirty content with liveReload enabled

Corner.Situation: Dirty direct-data or disk event with any preference/read-only flags
Corner.Expected: Local markdown remains unchanged and one existing conflict notification offers explicit reload.

Corner.Situation: Local edits occur during settle or an in-flight read
Corner.Expected: Read completion preserves those edits and routes to the conflict flow.

Corner.Situation: Tab closes/reopens or a newer external event supersedes a pending read
Corner.Expected: Old callbacks cannot overwrite the replacement tab or newer external content.

Corner.Situation: Clean preview/watch or ordinary liveReload tab
Corner.Expected: Supported automatic reload remains, snapshots and cursor survive, identical content does not emit a duplicate reload.

Corner.Situation: User confirms reload then edits before read completes
Corner.Expected: New edits require a fresh conflict choice; the earlier confirmation does not discard them.
